title: Hardship Cap Window by Length of Ostomy Supply Program Enrollment
content:
**Customer terms - Ostomy Supply Program.** The cap window replaces the last 24 months in the cap room of an Ostomy Supply Program financial-hardship waiver and follows how long the program has been enrolled, measured in whole calendar months from the program's enrolled date to the day the waiver is worked out.

| Months enrolled | Earlier hardship waivers added up against the cap |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | Those posted in the last 12 months |
| At least 12 but fewer than 36 | Those posted in the last 18 months |
| Fewer than 12 | Those posted in the last 24 months |

A waiver counts in a window of N months when fewer than N whole calendar months separate its posting date from the day the waiver is worked out. The hardship waivers posted in the cap window are the ones deducted from the cap to give the cap room, never below zero.

**Cases (hypothetical).** A program enrolled 40 months with a waiver posted 14 months ago: outside the 12-month window, so it does not reduce the room. The same waiver on a program enrolled 20 months: inside the 18-month window, so it does. A program enrolled exactly 36 months uses the 12-month window; at 35 months, the 18-month window.
